subject: [PATCH v4 02/19] selftests/mm: skip collapse_compound_extreme() where the PMD is too large

reviews.author: Lorenzo Stoakes (ARM)
reviews.summary: Acknowledged the issue with large PMD sizes and agreed that skipping the test case is a sensible solution.

2026-08-15.patch_summary: The patch modifies the selftests/mm/khugepaged.c test to skip the collapse_compound_extreme() function when the PMD size is larger than 32M, preventing a failure due to unreliable allocation of large pages.
